Do you think Brendan and Dinah should have broken up?
Do you want to see more of either character?

labels: All the best parts of life!

nodes.text: Brendan sprints over to the pinata and slides under it, catching it before it hits the ground!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wow! A pinata fairy!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That was pretty cool... Wasn't it, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It was, I suppose.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey! You should come to the party!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What party?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amanda! `Remember!` Taylor said at the meeting, 'No erds-nay at the arty-pay!'
nodes.text_bbcode: Amanda! [color=#3b78e2][i]Remember![/i][/color] Taylor said at the meeting, 'No erds-nay at the arty-pay!'

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Je m'appelle Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I guess I could make this one exception since you did save the pinata... You can come. Just don't do anything too nerdy, okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay... Wait... What's 'too nerdy?'

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No board games! No space discussions! No computer-speak! Just `try` to be cool, okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: No board games! No space discussions! No computer-speak! Just [color=#3b78e2][i]try[/i][/color] to be cool, okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey! I'm cool! I'm cool as a cucumber in a field of iceberg... Lettuce.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And don't say things like that!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't understand... So only this nerd can come to the party? Why is he so special?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, he's not special! It's just...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine! `All` nerds can come to the party! Are you happy?
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! [color=#3b78e2][i]All[/i][/color] nerds can come to the party! Are you happy?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I am!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I just got a text from Dinah! I've gotta go if I'm going to catch the bus to the college!

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: But your training...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'll just have to wing it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah is very passionate about Blood Baby's music, and their music is very controversial!

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Perfect!

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Uh... Brendan? You spacing out?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Warscrewdriver!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'd choose Warscrewdriver!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... Brendan, didn't you say Dinah wasn't into Warscrewdriver anymore?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She isn't... But `I` am...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You'd probably want to pick something she's into... Something controversial like Blood Baby!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oooh... Yeah, that is better.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: You need to master two crucial skills if you're going to impress your girl...

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: The first is cooking a meal for her. Let's start there. How much time do you have before your date?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Um, it's tonight...

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Wow.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, doing things last minute `is` in the college spirit, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, doing things last minute [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] in the college spirit, right?

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: True, true... Oh! I've got the perfect meal! You should cook instant noodles for her!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Instant noodles? Aren't those kind of... Simple?

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Extremely. But you want to seem like a college guy, and noodles and college are synonymous.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Let me put it this way... Every college guy is majoring in their own thing... But we're all `minoring` in noodles!
nodes.text_bbcode: Let me put it this way... Every college guy is majoring in their own thing... But we're all [color=#e23b3b][i]minoring[/i][/color] in noodles!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Heh. I'm in. How do I cook them?

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: The trick to making perfect noodles is to microwave them for `twenty seconds` exactly! No more, no less.
nodes.text_bbcode: The trick to making perfect noodles is to microwave them for [color=#e23b3b][i]twenty seconds[/i][/color] exactly! No more, no less.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Shouldn't he serve them with something else?

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: That's the best part! You can buy sauce at the store and just pour it on when the noodles are ready!

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: As long as the noodles are cooked precisely, she'll be satisfied! What's more, she'll think you're really independent, which is part of what college is about!

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: After all, if you can take care of her needs, you can easily take care of your own.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa. College is `intense.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa. College is [color=#e23b3b][i]intense.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: That brings me to the second skill, which I like to call the $USR Blitz System.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Blitz System? Will I have to play football for this? Because I don't own any athletic sneakers.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Relax. There's no football involved.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Great. I don't even think I'd know which goal to kick the ball into.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Yikes...

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Moving on... The Blitz System is designed for you to seem deep when your girl is talking about issues she really cares about... `Even if you don't know anything about those issues!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Moving on... The Blitz System is designed for you to seem deep when your girl is talking about issues she really cares about... [color=#e23b3b][i]Even if you don't know anything about those issues![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How do I do that?

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: There are three steps to the Blitz System...

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: `One.` Bring up a topic that you know she's passionate about.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]One.[/i][/color] Bring up a topic that you know she's passionate about.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: `Two.` Master the phrase 'Go on!'.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Two.[/i][/color] Master the phrase 'Go on!'.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: `Three.` Emphatically repeat the last thing she says.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Three.[/i][/color] Emphatically repeat the last thing she says.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I do like systems!

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: All right! Let's do a quick drill! First, what topic would you pick?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'd pick...

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Magic? Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, well, I `was`... Until just now when you asked if I was serious.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, well, I [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color]... Until just now when you asked if I was serious.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I thought girls liked magic...

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Yeah, magic `shows` are fun... But if you're a girl, a boyfriend who's into magic is not hot.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, magic [color=#e23b3b][i]shows[/i][/color] are fun... But if you're a girl, a boyfriend who's into magic is not hot.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Imagine someone pulling nickels from behind your ears `every day!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Imagine someone pulling nickels from behind your ears [color=#e23b3b][i]every day![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, that could get annoying. But what about making out? You can't tell me that's not important.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: It is. It is. There's no denying the power of good kissing chemistry...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I thought so.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: `At first.` But we're talking about a `relationship,` not just hooking up.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]At first.[/i][/color] But we're talking about a [color=#e23b3b][i]relationship,[/i][/color] not just hooking up.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: All right, Brendan! That's exactly right!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I `am` an above-average test-taker!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] an above-average test-taker!

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: So just as a follow-up, give me your best example of 'dining and discussion'. What would that look like on a date?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's easy! I'd take Dinah out for pizza, and we'd discuss... Well...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's up, Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The truth is... I don't know what we'd talk about. I guess I'd just ask how she's doing.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: That's good, but pizza and talking about her isn't going to cut it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It isn't?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Brendan? You okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The answer is on the tip of my tongue...

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: It's okay if you don't know, Brendan. That's what you're here for, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I don't know the answer.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I need you to help me become a college guy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah invited me to spend time with all her college friends, but I'm nervous!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She wants a guy who doesn't play Warscrewdriver... She wants a college guy... But I don't know how to be one.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You should just be yourself, Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, I think you both have the right idea.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, you do. Look, you should never be fake. You should always be Brendan. But, it would probably help your chances with Dinah if you were `the most mature, college-y Brendan possible.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, you do. Look, you should never be fake. You should always be Brendan. But, it would probably help your chances with Dinah if you were [color=#e23b3b][i]the most mature, college-y Brendan possible.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Can you help me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't, but my college friend, $USR, has been assisting Centerscore High's football team over the summer. I think he'll be able to give you a few maturity pointers.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This will be like leveling up my maturity!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... More than just `a few` pointers...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay... More than just [color=#e23b3b][i]a few[/i][/color] pointers...

nodes.text: The next day, Brendan and Howard meet up with Howard's friend, $USR, at the Centerscore High football field!

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Hey, Howard! Good to see you, man!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good to see you too, $USR!

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: I got your phone message. You're Brendan, right? You want to seem more like a college guy, so you can impress your girl?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's me...

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: I want to assess just how much work we have in front of us. We'll start with a quick test.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Besides appearance, what are the two things that impress college girls the most?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Her idea of a party is to turn off all the lights and read poetry over candle flames.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hmm, that's very true. Brendan took me to a Dinah party once, and I fell asleep on my candle.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: He set his arm on fire!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys, you're probably right. But if my time in France taught me anything, it's that new environments can change people. You might be surprised by the things Dinah's into now.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That might be true for you, but I still don't think Dinah would be into a high school party.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean, she just finished up a poetry class `and` the play she wrote is called 'Chrysanthemums in Winter'.
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, she just finished up a poetry class [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] the play she wrote is called 'Chrysanthemums in Winter'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Then, you're totally right! She won't have fun at a Taylor party!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But that does bring up the reason I came to see you in the first place, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So, she can't come to a `high school` party!
nodes.text_bbcode: So, she can't come to a [color=#e23b3b][i]high school[/i][/color] party!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What's Dinah going to think when she finds out the party's filled with a bunch of immature, rowdy high-schoolers?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey! We're mature!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe you're embarrassed by us, Brendan! How are we any more rowdy than college students?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No offense, Howard, but I don't think you'll find many eating contests at college parties...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? College parties are where the eating contest was `invented!` What did you think happens at them?
nodes.text_bbcode: What? College parties are where the eating contest was [color=#e23b3b][i]invented![/i][/color] What did you think happens at them?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know, philosophical discussions and mathematically-based party games!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't really know much about college, do you, Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No... That's actually why I came to see you in the first place, Howard.
Brendan sprints toward the pinata, but he trips! As he falls, he grabs onto Taylor for balance!
Taylor falls on top of him, and the pinata follows, crashing on top of them!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is that a new dance move?
Taylor pushes herself back up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you doing, Brendan?!
Amanda lifts up the bruised pinata.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: At least there still `is` a pinata, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: At least there still [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a pinata, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah! A ruined one! Urrg! Nerds!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: That reminds me, I've been trying to get a hold of you because I wanted to ask you to come spend time with me!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Like, on a date?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Well, since I just finished up my Final, I wanted you to come out to the movies with me and my classmates to celebrate!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: You mean, your `college` classmates?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, your [color=#e23b3b][i]college[/i][/color] classmates?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Uh... So, it's not a date?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: It's just hanging out, Brendan. Like a college student! In fact, you can be an honorary college guy!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Great! I'll see you tomorrow night then!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: See you then...
Dinah logs off.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How'd it go?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm doomed... I don't know the first thing about college life.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't even know how to do my own laundry! What's a spin cycle?! Do I own any delicates?! How do I avoid the lint trap?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Laundry's easy, Brendan! { { {  To take away your laundry pains, spot-treat all those pesky stains! { { {

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... I'm going to ignore that laundry jingle.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Fair enough.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I might not know `exactly` why Dinah ditched me at Prom, but I'm pretty sure it's because I'm still in high school. I need to be more like a college guy!
nodes.text_bbcode: I might not know [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] why Dinah ditched me at Prom, but I'm pretty sure it's because I'm still in high school. I need to be more like a college guy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But you said you don't know anything about college life!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't... But Howard might! He's friends with all kinds of college students. He's at the mall today with $ZOE. I've gotta go find him!
At the party store in the mall, Howard, $ZOE, and the cheerleaders are gathering up goodies for Taylor's Last Day of Summer party!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So what'd you miss most about Centerscore while you were in Paris?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean besides you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. Yes, Miss Sappy. Besides me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hmmm, that's a tough one.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Benedict $ZOE!  Less France talk, more party shopping! You're responsible for the decorations! If those streamers don't stream perfectly, I'm putting you in the Lyle suit next year instead of Jill!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Really? Do you mean it, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I mean it.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: The suit's not that bad, $ZOE. Once you get used to the heat... And people stepping on the tail... And Ryan making lewd comments about wanting to kiss your forked tongue.
Across the store, Jessica and Amanda are lugging a humongous pinata shaped like the Wilson High badger. Their arms wobble as they try to steady it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica! Amanda! Don't carry that by yourselves! It's too heavy! You'll drop it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is Taylor psychic?
Taylor runs over to them angrily!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can tell you who I did `not` miss.
nodes.text_bbcode: I can tell you who I did [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] miss.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We need a way to send `her` to France.
nodes.text_bbcode: We need a way to send [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] to France.

nodes.text: Brendan comes running up from the other side of the mall, out of breath!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Howard, there you are! Crisis! Third degree!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is it? Did Dex get his head stuck in a vase again?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, that's `second` degree! This is serious... I...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, that's [color=#e23b3b][i]second[/i][/color] degree! This is serious... I...

nodes.text: Before Brendan can finish his thought...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Errrg! Jessica! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't hold it! It's slipping!
The pinata starts to slip...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taylor `is` psychic!
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] psychic!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `NOOOOOOOO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NOOOOOOOO![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I can save it!

nodes.prompt: Run over there! Slide under the pinata and save it!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: My play?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Yeah, 'Chrysanthemums in Winter'. I got the title right this time, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: You did, and I'm glad you remember that I was involved in a play...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: But that was a while ago. We already had a showing for it.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Yeah, Brendan, I sent you an invitation... But you couldn't make it because it was Finals week. Don't you remember?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Oh... Riiiiiight... Yeah! I totally remember!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: That's okay. I understand if you don't remember. It's just been a long time since we talked to each other.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: You remembered! Thanks for asking, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: How could I forget? You told me all about how your professor always talks in haikus.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: I guess sometimes I can't tell if you're actually listening...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I listen to you. Stuff you do matters to me. I care about you.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Whoa! That was a haiku, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: It was?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I guess poetry's rubbing off on me!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Awww... I miss you.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: I don't want to hurt your feelings, Brendan, but...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: I'm kind of over Warscrewdriver Online.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Whaaaaa? You are?! But I thought you loved Warscrewdriver... Don't you?!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Yeah, I did once. But now it feels more like a high school thing. I have so much going on now, I just don't have time for video games.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I can't believe it...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Brendan. Let's talk about you, okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: It's been so long! What's been going on?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Well, let's see... I just picked up the Juggernaut Helmet, so I think I'm finally ready to take down the Whelkmor of Quoyeras! I think the key will be to...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Brendan, I meant, 'What's been going with you in real life?'

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Oh, real life. Right... Let's see...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I went snorkeling with the guys at the water park! We thought we saw a rare sea slug, but it turned out to be just a wad of dark socks!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Oh, that's... Not gross at all...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I went camping, too!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: That sounds like fun! What happened there?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Hector has a 'magic' steam room that gives visions to anyone who sits in it!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Cool! Did you have any visions?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Uh... Um, yeah, but they weren't interesting or anything. I just saw some stuff about... Stuff.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Oh... Well, has anything else happened?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Let's see... Is there anything else...? Ummm... Oh!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Dex got his head stuck in `another` vase! It was `so` funny!
nodes.text_bbcode: Dex got his head stuck in [color=#e23b3b][i]another[/i][/color] vase! It was [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] funny!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: ...Same old, same old, huh?
Brendan covers the microphone with his hand.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I think I'm boring her...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whenever I'm boring my girlfriend, Prissy, I just talk about Space 'Splosions!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Prissy is the girlfriend you're talking about? I didn't think you guys were actually an official couple!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I never thought to ask her! Is there some paperwork I need to fill out?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Um... You're right, though. Maybe I should talk about something Dinah's interested in instead.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmmm. What has she been up to most recently? I should ask her about her...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: In fact, I have never heard of such a trinket as a 'cell phone'. Is it made of wood?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Whatever its make, should I ever see such a contraption, I'm sure it would require the constant upkeep of the local blacksmith.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Er... I wonder how many `bat`s I'd have to kill from the land of `Ree` in order to `power` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Er... I wonder how many [color=#e23b3b][i]bat[/i][/color]s I'd have to kill from the land of [color=#e23b3b][i]Ree[/i][/color] in order to [color=#e23b3b][i]power[/i][/color] it.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: I guess it's not that big of a deal. Sometimes I can barely understand you even when we do talk...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: No, I'm trying to... The `bat`s. From `Ree.` `Bat.` `Ree.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I'm trying to... The [color=#e23b3b][i]bat[/i][/color]s. From [color=#e23b3b][i]Ree.[/i][/color] [color=#e23b3b][i]Bat.[/i][/color] [color=#e23b3b][i]Ree.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I just got really hooked on this new cell phone game! I played for so long, I didn't even notice how much time had passed until my battery died!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: That explains it.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: It's really fun! It's about this sarcastic detective and his really pretty partner. She's an FBI agent. You make choices to try and solve cases!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: That `does` sound fun!
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] sound fun!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to worry you...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: I `was` worried.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] worried.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You can always sign on to talk to me!

nodes.title: A College Date
nodes.subtitle: Can Brendan keep up with Dinah's college crowd?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, why?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I don't know. You seem... Different.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: From what I hear, athletes work exceptionally hard to reach the highest level of physical excellence possible.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But that's just what you `hear,` Brendan. You don't really know anything about sports.
nodes.text_bbcode: But that's just what you [color=#3b78e2][i]hear,[/i][/color] Brendan. You don't really know anything about sports.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, no. I mean, I was recently `on` a football field. Right next to the wickets. But that probably doesn't count...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, no. I mean, I was recently [color=#e23b3b][i]on[/i][/color] a football field. Right next to the wickets. But that probably doesn't count...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's just a fact of life... People don't care about poetry with the same fervor as sports!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What about `you` though, Brendan? Don't you agree? Don't you think what poets have to contribute to society is valuable? Shouldn't poets be able to make millions of dollars off of what they love?
nodes.text_bbcode: What about [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] though, Brendan? Don't you agree? Don't you think what poets have to contribute to society is valuable? Shouldn't poets be able to make millions of dollars off of what they love?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, um...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Absolutely! I don't understand why Shakespeare died penniless when these Neanderthals make all this money just for having advanced motor skills?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's outrageous!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It `is` outrageous!
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] outrageous!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm glad you see it that way!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You know, this got me thinking about another issue... Why are athletes paid so much more money than poets?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: A gazillion dollars to catch a ball?! Does that enrich the soul?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I don't know. That's just how I feel. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Eeep! I don't know anything about poetry `or` sports...
nodes.text_bbcode: Eeep! I don't know anything about poetry [color=#e23b3b][i]or[/i][/color] sports...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uhhh... I never thought about it like that...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Exactly! So you understand?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I do!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: A part of what?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know... The whole?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Have you been listening?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry...
Brendan stares at Dinah blankly...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan? You're creeping me out...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, sorry...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... So now I'm supposed to emphatically repeat the last thing she said!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `So, when you listen to Blood Baby, it's like you're listening to...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]So, when you listen to Blood Baby, it's like you're listening to...[/i][/color]

options.label: All the best parts of life!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I don't see how music can ever be held responsible for that level of persistent emotion!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Those people have never really listened to their music...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: When I listen to `Blood Baby`, it's like I'm listening to all the best parts of life.
nodes.text_bbcode: When I listen to [color=#3b78e2][i]Blood Baby[/i][/color], it's like I'm listening to all the best parts of life.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, you okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So... You're not okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, I'm fine I was just, um... Disagreeing with you?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait... You think Blood Baby's music causes depression?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoops... I meant to say 'Go on!'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No... I meant 'No way!' like, 'No way! That's unbelievable!'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, I just got so confused... Of course Blood Baby doesn't `cause` depression...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, okay... Good... I just feel like when I'm listening, it's like I'm listening to all the best parts of life.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Don't worry. The night is still young.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Yeah! Movies are like tonight's appetizer, but the club is the entree!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The club?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Yeah, there's this new club downtown called Fate!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh! I really wanted to check that out!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: The line forms pretty early! We should go now!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm really sorry, guys, but I don't think I can get into any club... I'm too young.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Awww, man. Bummer.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Actually, it shouldn't be too big of a deal.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: He's right. The bouncers at these clubs hardly ever check for ID.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah really wants to get into this club... I just want to go home.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I should do what makes her happy...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, then... Let's see if we can get me in!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You mean it? Even after this whole thing with the movies?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure! We might as well try, right?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You're the best!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Eeep! What happens if I can't get in?!
Brendan, Dinah, and Adam pull up to Fate in Adam's truck!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Whoa! Look how long the line is!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan and I can hold a spot in line while you look for parking...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Cool.
Brendan and Dinah exit the truck and step into the back of the line.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It doesn't look like my other friends are here yet.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now's my chance to try $USR's Blitz System! First, I'll bring up Blood Baby...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do you think Blood Baby's somber-toned music contributes to depression?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?! Blood Baby's music is what keeps people from `being` depressed!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding me?! Blood Baby's music is what keeps people from [color=#3b78e2][i]being[/i][/color] depressed!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa! I think that's probably the passionate response I want!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now I just need to say the phrase $USR said I should master...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah! Come on! We should see the movie with your friends!
In the theater, Brendan slinks down in his seat.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The movie hasn't even started yet, and I'm already scared!
An hour into the movie...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Eeeep! Don't open the door! Protect your bones!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Eeeep! Don't open the door! Protect your bones![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Just then, a hand clamps down on Brendan's shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `YAAAAAAHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YAAAAAAHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Thought you could pull a fast one on Monte, did you?! I'm going to need to see some ID, young man!
Brendan offers up his library card...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Come along, son!
Monte escorts Brendan out of the theater. Dinah follows. Soon, all her friends come out.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sorry. You should all go back in there and see the rest of the movie.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's okay. Right, guys?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I guess we'll see it some other time.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: It was just getting good!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I told you it was scary!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's go see 'Fluffy'.
Brendan and Dinah sit down in the movie theater, which is filled with kids yelling and running around.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I feel so embarrassed...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: This is really cute! I'm actually kind of excited for this! It's like I'm a little kid again!
Dinah takes Brendan's hand...
After the movie, Brendan and Dinah walk toward the parking lot to meet up with Dinah's friends.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That was really fun, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, it was! I really loved the golden hydrant scene!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That was pretty good!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Hey, where were you guys?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: You missed the best movie I've ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: It was `so` good! They stole bones I didn't even know people had!
nodes.text_bbcode: It was [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] good! They stole bones I didn't even know people had!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's okay, it's not your fault... I still had fun. I just don't know who I'm going to watch it with now that all my friends have seen it...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: How can you be together if he's not that into poetry? Dinah, you're all about poetry!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're together because we make sacrifices for each other. I find ways to enjoy her poetry.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: And what sacrifices does Dinah make?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah once created a Warscrewdriver account in order to help me level up high enough to get a sword I really wanted.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: That's sweet, Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It was. It was really sweet.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But it was a long time ago...
Brendan, Dinah, and Adam arrive at the movies and meet some of Dinah's other college friends in the ticket line.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hi, guys!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Hey, roomie! Hey, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Dinah! Adam! The movie starts in like ten minutes!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What movie?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I completely forgot to tell you, Brendan! We're going to see 'The Bone Thieves'!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Bone thieves? That sounds scary...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: It is. My cousin said it was so scary he has to sleep with the lights on now!
Brendan sees Officer Monte just outside the theater doors, checking ID's!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I don't care if you've got a mustache, kid! You're not getting in to this one without valid ID!

nodes.speaker: Older Man
nodes.text: But I'm not a kid!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Tough!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Um, Dinah, can I talk to you for a second?
Brendan pulls Dinah aside.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What's this movie rated?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, it's definitely R-rated. I think one guy gets his bones ripped out through his... Well, I don't want to ruin it for you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm not sure I can see this movie...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I don't think it'll be `that` bad. Heh. I'll just cover your eyes during the scary parts.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think it'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] bad. Heh. I'll just cover your eyes during the scary parts.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, that's not it. I'm talking about the fact that I'm underage.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I totally forgot! Um... I guess you and I could see something else that's playing at the same time...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But the only movie playing at the same time is... `'Fluffy'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But the only movie playing at the same time is... [color=#e23b3b][i]'Fluffy'.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's that kids' movie about the big pink dog and his friends, the tiny soft kitten and the sad, little piglet who always needs hugs...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess I could just see that with you...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Come on, guys! It's going to start soon!
Dinah's friends head into the theater showing 'The Bone Thieves'.
Just then, Officer Monte leaves his post for the restroom!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Or... I could sneak in...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to do that?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I, um, really liked the imagery!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Cool, man. Which images?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, you know, the... Anger that is a ball that you threw?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, that's basically the same thing `I` said.
nodes.text_bbcode: Brendan, that's basically the same thing [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] said.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, right. Well, it was just `so` strong.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, right. Well, it was just [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] strong.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: If you didn't really like it, why didn't you just say so in the first place?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hurl your anger! Hurl it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Adam. Brendan's just trying to be nice. To be honest, he doesn't really like poetry that much.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: He doesn't? I just assumed... Wait...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I didn't really like it... But to my credit, I don't really like poetry much. Please don't squish me...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: That's really honest, man. And honesty's the first step toward expressing yourself.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I like this guy, Dinah. He was up-front with me.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I like him, too.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Wait...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: `Yugg!` Brendan, these noodles are ice-cold!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yugg![/i][/color] Brendan, these noodles are ice-cold!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: They are?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I thought I cooked them for the right amount of time...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: `Blegh...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Blegh...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's okay, Brendan. I see that you're trying to step out of your comfort zone.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe a little `too` far...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe a little [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] far...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But at least you're trying...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: To be honest, I'm not sure I would have enjoyed the noodles all that much anyway.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Noodles are like all I eat in college!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: They are?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... Just the other day, one of the guys on the football team threw a party, and he served noodles that looked `exactly` like these.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Just the other day, one of the guys on the football team threw a party, and he served noodles that looked [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] like these.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I bet I know him...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I don't think so.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If I can't get noodles right, how am I ever going to cook for Dinah?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm really impressed!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Then... Why aren't you eating more?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's nothing, I'm just... Um... Not that hungry?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, wait, look... I don't want to lie to you. The truth is, noodles are like all I eat in college!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: They are?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... Just the other day, one of the guys on the football team threw a party, and he served noodles that tasted `exactly` like these.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Just the other day, one of the guys on the football team threw a party, and he served noodles that tasted [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] like these.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I bet I know him...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Anyway, even if I `am` sick of them, it's nice to see this `independent` side of you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, even if I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] sick of them, it's nice to see this [color=#3b78e2][i]independent[/i][/color] side of you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Even though I got the noodles right, will Dinah expect me to cook things for her all the time now?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't think I really like cooking...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe I should finally talk to Dinah about what I'm feeling...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah... I wanted to...
Dinah's phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's Adam!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Who's Adam?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: He's from my poetry class! Come on! He's giving us a ride to the movies!
A little while later, Brendan sits against the passenger side door of Adam's truck. Dinah sits squeezed in between Brendan and Adam.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: So, what kind of car do you drive, Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Adam...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I don't have a license.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Oh yeah, that's right. Duh. You're still in high school. But wait, aren't you old enough to have your license?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I am. I just haven't gotten around to it.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Heh. I get it. Too much responsibility! So high school!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No! It's not that!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: It's okay. I used to be that way, too. I used to be different in a lot of ways, but poetry saved me.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, your poem! I totally forgot! I really want to hear the poem you were working on!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Sure! Ahem...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: The Winning Play, by Adam.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Fourth down. Two seconds. Need a score. Hut hut hike.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I hold my anger by the seams. 40 Fly. I hurl it toward the end zone.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: It flies... But never lands...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow, Adam. Just, wow.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Do you like it?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I love it! It's like you're hurling your anger into the sky!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: What did you think, Brendan? I could use an unbiased opinion.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I didn't really like Adam's poem! Should I pretend I did? Or should I tell him what I really thought?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This seems right. I remember it was a small amount of time... But I wonder why they aren't steaming...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's twenty seconds... Now that I think about it, I think $USR said thirty seconds!
Brendan lets the timer run out...
Brendan pulls the noodles from the microwave!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's fifteen seconds! Did I go too far?
Five more seconds elapse...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure it was more than ten seconds...
Five more seconds elapse...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know the time $USR gave me was more than five seconds...
Five more seconds elapse...
That night, Brendan meets Dinah at her dorm room...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Hi, Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Brendan! Hi!
She gives him a big hug!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: It's been forever! How was the bus ride over?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Scary! There was a guy sitting next to me who looked `exactly` like a death-elf!
nodes.text_bbcode: Scary! There was a guy sitting next to me who looked [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] like a death-elf!

nodes.text: That must have been weird...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You said you have a surprise for dinner tonight?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I do! Instead of going out to a restaurant, I've decided to cook a meal for you!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You have? I didn't know you could cook!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait a sec... You do know that frozen pizza does not count as a home-cooked meal, right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Of course, I, um, I wouldn't dream of serving frozen pizza as a legitimate meal.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: In a few short minutes, dinner will be served.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow, Brendan... Maybe you `have` made some changes...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, Brendan... Maybe you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] made some changes...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No peeking!
Brendan leaves for the dorm kitchen...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeep! She's going to know they're just instant noodles! What kind of a mess did $USR get me into?
Brendan puts the instant noodles into the microwave...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! How many seconds was I supposed to cook them for? I can't remember!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know! I'll just set the timer for thirty seconds and then pull them when the time seems right.
Brendan inputs 30 on the microwave and presses START.
Five seconds elapse...

nodes.text: The bouncer picks Brendan up...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Whooooa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whooooa![/i][/color]
